item.title: Severe turbulence injures at least 8 aboard Avianca flight, forcing emergency landing in Miami
item.description: At least eight people were injured when an Avianca flight encountered severe turbulence and had to make an emergency landing in Miami

item.title: Congregants celebrate the reconstruction of one of America's oldest Black churches
item.description: The First Baptist Church of Williamsburg, one of the oldest Black churches in the U.S., celebrated the reconstruction of its original meeting house with a re-dedication on Friday

item.title: Fire up the grills! Thousands of South Africans try to set a record for the biggest cookout
item.description: Thousands of determined and hungry South Africans descended on a sports stadium in an attempt to break the world record for the biggest cookout

item.title: Wynonna Judd faces 'The Hard Truth' on vulnerable new album, the first since her mother Naomi died
item.description: Wynonna Judd has released her first album in 10 years, “The Hard Truth.”

item.title: Linkin Park documentary 'Unshatter' tracks band's emotional return to recording, touring
item.description: Linkin Park is revealing the uncertainty, grief and creative risk behind its return in the new documentary “Linkin Park: Unshatter.”

item.title: Canadian author Anne Carson wins literature Nobel for 'bold and inventive' works that blend genres
item.description: Anne Carson, a Canadian poet and essayist, has won the Nobel Prize in literature

item.title: Trump establishes committee to investigate Federal Reserve's Lisa Cook in latest effort to fire her
item.description: President Donald Trump opened another chapter in his effort to fire Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook Friday by establishing a “committee of inquiry” to investigate allegations that she made false statements in mortgage applications

item.title: Trump honors Microsoft’s CEO after Vance drops an H-1B visa hammer on the company
item.description: President Donald Trump celebrated tech billionaires such as Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella at an event with arguably awkward timing

item.title: FACT FOCUS: Trump says tariffs have brought more US auto factories. His numbers are off.
item.description: As President Donald Trump crisscrosses the country to rally support for Republican candidates, he is touting his economic agenda and crediting tariffs with economic growth — including what he says are more vehicle manufacturing plants all over the country

item.title: Judge convicts 3 Mexicans in the killings of 2 Australian brothers and American friend on surf trip
item.description: A local judge has found three Mexicans guilty of murdering two Australian brothers and their American friend in Baja California

item.title: FlyDubai co-pilot intended to crash plane into Tel Aviv airport, UAE prosecutor says
item.description: Authorities in the United Arab Emirates say a FlyDubai co-pilot attacked the captain of a flight to Tel Aviv last month intending to crash the plane into Israel’s main airport terminal

item.title: Russian attacks kill 7 in Ukraine after Trump strikes diesel deal with Putin
item.description: Russian aerial bombs hit residential buildings in Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia region, killing seven people, including three children, and wounding at least 10, officials said Saturday

item.title: Boosting US oil supplies with Russian diesel unlikely to have much impact on prices, experts say
item.description: A new pact that calls for Russia to boost the U.S. supply of diesel over the next few months is unlikely to make a dent in painfully high prices at the pump or elsewhere, energy policy experts say

item.title: Hurricane Isaias could nudge fuel prices higher if Gulf of Mexico refineries lose power
item.description: Hurricane Isaias is forecast to miss the oil industry’s biggest hubs along the Gulf Coast

item.title: FBI arrests suspect in ShinyHunters hack of the bureau's jobs portal
item.description: The FBI has arrested an accused co-conspirator of the hacking group ShinyHunters
